text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
All right, today we're studying 
techniques! Let's make this magic trick 
absolutely flawless, Mabe-chin!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Of course! With our duo illusion, let's 
make e~veryone marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, you two. Practicing magic 
tricks?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yup! We're gonna debut it at the upcoming 
Fan Gathering!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the stage event! In fact, I'm 
scheduled to perform there too. Leading 
off first, naturally!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that punchline was great! Our comedy 
routine is gonna sweep the fans into a 
vortex of laughter~!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Our a cappella performance will definitely 
touch their hearts...! Come on, let's sing 
it from the top one more time!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is everyone else practicing for the 
stage too...?! Incredible, they're so 
fired up!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Well, you see... It's all thanks 
to you, Bubble☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember? Do you remember? When you 
filled in for that play!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Taking up a sudden stand-in role without 
showing even a hint of fear—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Bubble-san do that lit a fire in 
everyone's hearts! They all wanted to try 
stepping up fearlessly too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya and Mabe are doing our special magic 
trick! Maya chants a spell, and vanishes 
from the stage in an instant—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Then I summon a UFO, and Mayano reappears 
right out of it! A truly 
MARVELOUS☆SPECTACLE★☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Both Maya and I want to fill everyone with 
thrilling excitement. ...Without losing to 
Bubble!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Ahaha! I love it, now I'm getting 
fired up too!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
At a Fan Gathering bursting with this much 
passion... as the vanguard spearhead, I 
can't put on anything half-baked!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hear my declaration, you two. As the 
charge captain... I'm going to hype up 
this crowd more than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Fan Gathering. When I 
arrived at the venue, the stage event had 
just kicked off.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Everrrryone! Are you having fun out 
there?!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
To get you all even more hyped up, let's 
blow past the limit right from the start! 
—"NEXT FRONTIER"!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Along this chosen path~♪ Running earnestly 
till the end~♪

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO! Let's gooo! BUBBLEEE!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
...Her voice... is so beautiful... ......I 
could listen to this forever...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, let me hear your voices too! Let all 
those bursting emotions out... and let's 
make this the best stage ever!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—YEAAAAAAAH! HEY! HEY!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, amazing! Bubble-san playing the 
guitar... is sparkling so much!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Delivering perfectly on the vanguard duty 
is seriously incredible☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
We can't lose either! Just like this, even 
more, much, much more! Let's make everyone 
marvelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Fan Gathering drew to a close amid 
immense cheers! As I was helping pack up 
the venue—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Phew! ...Ahaha. Incredible, my heart is 
still pounding...!
choice_data_list:
Great work! You were the best opening act 
ever!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I think so too. I really have to 
thank everyone.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Because everyone else was so fired up... 
it made me want to charge out as a worthy 
vanguard.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
As the charge captain, I can't afford to 
show anything pathetic, after all!
